87. Let R be the region in the first quadrant bounded above by the graph of y = In(3 - x), for 0 ≤ x ≤ 2. R is
the base of a solid for which each cross section perpendicular to the x-axis is a square. What is the volume of
the solid?
(A) 0.442
(B) 1.029
(C) 1.296
(D) 3.233
(E) 4.071
